name: DMBI CRITIC Objective Weight Development

normalization.scope: Within each Forecast_Target_Date x Horizon_Months decision matrix of 25 districts
normalization.constant_group_rule: If a criterion is constant within one decision matrix, all districts receive normalized value 0.5 for that criterion.

critic.contrast: Population standard deviation of normalized criterion

operational_weight_design: One common CRITIC weight vector is estimated from all normalized 2024 month/horizon decision matrices and frozen for H1/H3/H6.
horizon_specific_weights: Calculated for diagnostic comparison only and not used operationally.
next_step: Step 29E: apply the frozen 2024 CRITIC weights in TOPSIS to 2025 retrospective validation criteria.
interpretation: CRITIC weights measure objective information contrast and conflict among the three DMBI planning criteria. They are not causal-effect weights and are not clinical importance scores.
